Advocate) This petition coming on for admission this day, the cou the following:- Bherusingh Jamod vs Public Health And Family Welfare ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4988017/ 1 Signature Not Verified Signed by: Neeraj Sarvate Signing time: 20-03-2024 14:05:01 2 Order 1. By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India the petitioner has claimed the following reliefs :- "(a) It is therefore prayed that this petition may kindly be allowed and the Hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass an appropriate writ, order or direction to the respondents to convene special review Departmental PromotionCommittee meeting for considering the claim of the petitioner for promotion on the post of Food Safety Officer (Food Inspector Higher Pay-Scale Grade) and to promote the petitioner on the said post with effect from the due date dated 28.11.2015 with all consequential benefits in the interest of justice.
texts.facts: His name was included in the gradation list dated 01.04.2014 on the basis of merit and he was placed at serial No.8. His promotion on the post of Food Safety Inspector is due from 28.11.2015 as on that day one of the employee of the respondent department was promoted on the post of Senior Food Inspector and two posts are available in the respondent department. His contention is that the respondents are bound to conduct the DPC twice in every single year but they are not doing so despite similarly situated persons having been considered and so promoted. Due to non-consideration of his name for promotion he has been deprived of his fundamental right of being considered for promotion.
